title: Use the common zero rather than an unknown phase gain
statement: Conditional CPTP Duhamel/oddness gives |b(delta)-delta s_T|<=|delta T|^3/6 and the correct sign for |delta|T<=1/2. A three-way half-interval bracket uses history-conditioned bounded martingale differences and level failure alpha_j=alpha*2^(j-K). Its complete interrogation sum has no extra log(1/epsilon); the unknown nuisance law may change with commands/history. Calibration failure may be added only when its good event warrants the uniform subsequent conditional contract, not from one observed random radius.
